Gold Farms

US PvP Alliance · prices at Mon 23 Nov 22:25 · cheapest auction

Where a level 60 can make gold solo in the open world, and what to stock before the raids. Drop chances are vanilla figures (Wowhead Classic where we have the page, VMaNGOS otherwise); WoW Forever may have changed some, and Forever-only items are listed from guide sites. Mob and item names open Wowhead; the BB tag beside an item opens its BootyBayBroker price history. Wowhead pages fetched so far: 143.

Best leadsMiningMobs to farmRare spawnsMount HyjalEvery mob that drops itRaid prep

Best leads for you

For a level 60 warrior with Mining and Alchemy, solo in the open world. Prices are live; drop chances from Wowhead where we have the page, otherwise VMaNGOS.

Transmute: Arcanite
24 77 per transmute

Arcanite BarBB sells for 37 49; Arcane CrystalBB 10 69 + Thorium BarBB 16. You have Alchemy and Mining: mined crystals make it nearly all profit. About 2-day cooldown.

Mine Heavy Thorium Veins, Mount Hyjal
Fel CrystalBB 12 20

TorberniteBB 3 75. Guides say both come from Heavy Thorium Veins in Hyjal (rare, fel-smoke Rich Thorium look); others say the source is unknown, so confirm in game. Fel Crystal is the Legionite transmute input.

Recipe farm: Greater Nature Protection
2 64 a kill from the recipe

Recipe: Greater Nature Protection PotionBB 79 99, drop 3.30% (Wowhead). Rotting Behemoth / Decaying Horror, Western Plaguelands, 55–57, not elite. You can also learn it: the potion has none listed before the raids.

Recipe farm: Greater Shadow Protection
58 a kill from the recipe

Recipe: Greater Shadow Protection PotionBB 35 44, drop 1.64% (Wowhead). Dark Adept / Shadowmage, Eastern Plaguelands (Northdale area), 58–60, not elite.

Crusader formula
1 17 a kill from the recipe

Formula: Enchant Weapon - CrusaderBB 280 98, drop 0.42% (Wowhead). Scarlet Spellbinder, Western Plaguelands, 57–58, not elite. A lottery: about 1 in 240 kills at Wowhead's rate, and it rarely sells, so it is a bonus rather than income.

Elemental lieutenants (when they are up)
one kill pays an essence or more

The Windreaver (Silithus) 152 42; Princess Tempestria (Winterspring) 36 76; Baron Charr (Un'Goro Crater) 28 96; Avalanchion (Azshara) 48 85. Single named elites with big essence drops; check whether they spawn in Forever.

Open-world mobs level 40+ with at least 8 spawn points, ranked by value per kill: expected drops at today's cheapest auction plus the coin they drop and the vendor value of their greys. Slow sellers (under 0.5 sold a day) are counted at full price and marked: they are the rare drops worth farming for, but expect to wait for a buyer. Very rare world drops (under 0.05% each) are left out. Per 100 kills makes it easy to compare with how fast you kill. A mob matches the level filter if any of its levels is in range.
